headlines.title: Russia says no plague found in contacts of Siberian lab worker who died
headlines.description: News that a female staffer had died from a “pneumonia of undetermined” origin last week has spread fears worldwide.

headlines.title: Trump says he plans to speak with Putin about possible pneumonic plague case in Russia
headlines.description: Trump has said that the U.S. was willing to help Russia, where the death of a staffer at an anti-plague lab has sparked global public health concerns.

headlines.title: Trump to talk with Putin ‘very soon’ about death at anti-plague lab
headlines.description: President Trump said he would speak with Russian President Putin ‘very soon’ following the mysterious death of a lab worker at an anti-plague lab in Siberia. NBC News’ Anne Thompson reports.

headlines.title: US Calls for Transparency on Reported Russian Plague Death
headlines.description: Russian officials are facing mounting questions after the mysterious death of a 28-year-old Russian researcher at a lab in Siberia that studies plagues. Now, U.S. health officials are calling for Russia to release more information about the death and prevent a potential outbreak. “Something like that gets out, it could quickly spread so we’re watching and monitoring it closely,” Secretary of State Marco Rubio said. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Why You Should Be Wary of Cholesterol Advice on Social Media
headlines.description: An analysis of social media content shows that almost half of cholesterol-related videos on TikTok are inaccurate and potentially harmful. NBC’s Dr. Natalie Azar joins TODAY to set the record straight, explain how high cholesterol is a risk for a heart attack, and breaks down why LDL levels are not one size fits all.

headlines.title: NY Declares Measles Emergency; Pennsylvania Cases Surge
headlines.description: After 26 years of official elimination status, the measles are making a concerning comeback in the United States, with the CDC reporting more than 3,800 cases across 47 states in 2026. New York’s Gov. Kathy Hochul has declared a statewide “disaster emergency,” while in Pennsylvania there are more than 1,000 confirmed cases in the latest outbreak. NBC’s Anne Thompson reports for TODAY.
